messages:
Samir K.: quick heads-up from vuln triage — OpenSSL CVE flagged some older instances using RSA-AES ciphers in eu-west and ap-south. I want to propose a cert sweeping + mTLS policy sync across regions. We need input on KMS-wrapped private keys, RBAC for issuance, and audit logging retention.
Mira L.: ugh, yeah. what are you thinking for compatibility with external customers of the hosted API? we can’t break client TLS.
Samir K.: hosts should remain TLS1.2+ with a compatibility mode for 7 days during rollout. service-to-service (internal) should jump to TLS1.3 + mandatory mTLS (ECDHE, AEAD only). will do a canary in staging and one non-prod region first.
Alex P.: runtime note — envoy/proxy hot-reload is fine but we need to confirm cert-manager auto-renew hooks and KV cache invalidation for the token store. if reloads are frequent we might see 1-2% P99 latency blips.
Kevin (infra): on KMS: we should store private keys encrypted with our HSM-backed KMS key. rotation: rotate KMS master keys quarterly, but per-cert keys should be rotated on renewal. question: who gets iam:Decrypt for cert unwrap? suggest a new RBAC group "cert-issuers" with MFA & time-limited grants. audit logs piped to secure bucket with 7y retention for enterprise customers.
cert-bot: automated-scan: found 12 services with weak cipher suites (RSA-AES, AES-CBC) and 3 cert chains expiring < 30d in eu-west. attached sample: service-batch-worker-3.
Mira L.: audit retention: for Private/VPC customers we need tenant-scoped audit views. we also need to make sure logs are redactable for PI. Can ops confirm storage/egress costs?
Kevin (infra): storage estimate about +1.2GB/day for global audit stream at full verbosity. we can tier that — hot 90 days, cold to glacier for compliance exports. Tenant-scoped views via IAM filters + Athena indexing.
Samir K.: quick TLS config snippet for envoy we want to standardize (canary):
```
common_tls_context:
  tls_params:
    tls_minimum_protocol_version: TLSv1_3
    cipher_suites: "TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384:TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256"
  tls_certificates:
    - certificate_chain: { filename: "/etc/certs/service.crt" }
      private_key: { filename: "/etc/certs/service.key" }
  alpn_protocols: "h2,http/1.1"
```
also enable require_client_certificate: true for internal clusters.
Alex P.: thanks. test plan idea: canary in staging -> canary in eu-west non-prod -> 48h perf + replay tests -> gradual 10% steps in prod regions. include synthetic evals for embeddings/generation latency.
Samir K.: vuln triage follow-up: for the 3 expiring chains, auto-issue new certs via cert-manager hooked to KMS unwrap. need an owner for the issuance runbook and RBAC change.
Kevin (infra): I can own the RBAC proposal. will create a terraform module for the "cert-issuers" group and tie to kms:Decrypt role with policy that requires a short-lived session.
ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-4921: "Cert sweep + mTLS policy rollout (eu/ap)" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFRA-4921
Mira L.: incident response Q: if a cert renewal fails mid-rollout, what's the fallback? can we auto-fail traffic to previous proxy pool and disable mTLS for 1h?
Samir K.: plan: rollout controller will mark unhealthy and rollback to last-known-good config; if accidental mass failures occur, ops can hit the emergency toggle to disable mTLS on the edge layer while keeping internal enforcement. runbook needs exact commands and owners.
Kevin (infra): I'll draft the RBAC/IAM PR + runbook snippets. assign to Alex for runtime tests, Samir for policy sign-off, Mira for compliance/audit acceptance.
Samir K.: action items: 1) Kevin — RBAC + KMS terraform (ETA 2d). 2) Alex — canary test harness + perf baseline (ETA 3d). 3) Mira — audit retention & tenant view spec (ETA 4d). 4) Samir — rollout plan + runbook (ETA 2d). ping @here if any blockers. :thumbsup:
